personenVerwaltung.deletePersonConfirm: Really delete {name}? All of their reference images will be removed.
personenVerwaltung.imageTipsText:
For good results, around 20–30 images per person work well, mixed roughly like this: 8–10 frontal, 5–8 slightly angled, 3–5 under different lighting conditions, and a few from real camera footage. If glasses, a cap, etc. are regularly worn, a few images with those should be included too.

CompreFace does not store a single "average face" — several images produce several embeddings that are compared against. Variation between images genuinely helps, but 20 nearly identical frames in a row add little.
